prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1394; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Conroe, Texas, I observed two vehicles in the northbound lane of the roadway with front-end damage consistent with a low-speed head-on collision. Driver 1 was operating the northbound vehicle and stated that Driver 2, operating the southbound vehicle, crossed into the northbound lane while attempting to pass a slow-moving truck. Driver 2 denied crossing the centerline and stated that Driver 1 drifted toward the center of the road. A Passenger was present in the front seat of Driver 2's vehicle and was evaluated at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported for medical evaluation. Airbag deployment was noted in the southbound vehicle. Both vehicles were driven from the roadway after tow was not required for either. Skid marks were not observed. Weather was clear and the road surface was dry. Citation issued to Driver 2 for failure to maintain a single lane. No further action taken at this time.
